subject.name: Fuels, Combustion and Emissions
aka: Alternative Fuels and Green Energy Systems

manipal: Alternative Fuels and Green Energy Systems

course_used.manipal: Alternative Fuels and Green Energy Systems (MTP 4422)

subtopics.t: Solid, liquid and gaseous fuels; coal characterization
Refining: distillation, cracking and catalytic reforming
Fuel properties: density, calorific value and viscosity
Flash point, fire point, pour point and vapour pressure
Fuel additives; octane and cetane ratings

where.title: Properties, Testing, and Additives
topics: ASTM and SAE standards and specifications
Types of fuels and their properties

other_units.name: Lubricants and Engine Friction
subtopics: Engine friction and effect of engine variables
Theories of lubrication: hydrodynamic, elasto-hydrodynamic, boundary
Bearing lubrication and lubrication systems
Lubricant base stocks and finished automotive lubricants
Classification and requirements of automotive lubricants
Lubricant properties, oxidation and additives
Engine coolants and their properties

other_units.name: Combustion Thermochemistry and Kinetics
subtopics: Stoichiometry and air-fuel ratio
Thermochemistry and property relations
Heat of reaction and heat of formation
Adiabatic flame temperature
Chemical equilibrium and products of combustion
Chemical kinetics: reaction rates and mechanisms
Chain reactions and explosion limits
Steady-state and partial-equilibrium approximations

other_units.name: Flames, Ignition and Detonation
subtopics: Conservation equations for reacting flows; Shvab-Zeldovich form
Laminar premixed flames: flame speed and thickness
Flammability limits, quenching and ignition
Methods of flame stabilization
Laminar diffusion flames
Droplet evaporation and burning
Turbulent premixed and diffusion flames
Deflagration, detonation and Rankine-Hugoniot relations
Solid propellant combustion and combustion instabilities

other_units.name: Emission Formation and Control
subtopics: Formation of NOx, CO, HC and sulphur oxides
Soot formation and sooting tendency
Influence of physical and chemical parameters on emissions
Emission measurement: gas analysers and smoke meters
Emission reduction: EGR and catalytic converters
Emission legislation and control strategies

other_units.name: Alternative Fuels and Fuel Cells
subtopics: Need for and availability of alternative fuels
Alcohols: ethanol, methanol, butanol; fermentation
Biodiesel and vegetable oils; transesterification
Gaseous fuels: CNG, LNG, LPG and landfill gas
Use in SI and CI engines; dual-fuel operation
Hydrogen fuel cells: PEMFC and SOFC
Future fuels: ammonia and new powertrains
